name: jumonji and AT-rich interaction domain containing 2
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: JARID2 encodes protein Jumonji. Annotated molecular activities include histone H3K27 methyltransferase activity and chromatin binding. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and chromatin remodeling.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to developmental delay with variable intellectual disability and dysmorphic facies (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

selection_reason: Panel membership; user authorized the complete proposed and reserve roster.
